The *Arūpadhammavavatthānadukkarapañha* ("The Question on Differentiating Formless Phenomena", Mil 3.7.16) is a dialogue situated in the *Milindapañha* section of the Pali canon [SuttaCentral]. Modern translations include an English rendering by John Kelly, with four translations listed in three languages on SuttaCentral [SuttaCentral].

In comparative Buddhist literature, SuttaCentral identifies a full parallel in the Chinese version of the Milinda dialogues, T 1670b 2.75 (*The Buddha Could Comprehend Difficult Things*) [SuttaCentral]. DharmaNexus detects extensive Pali-internal text reuse, recording thirty-six matching passages across six Pali works [DharmaNexus]. The text shares significant phrasing with post-canonical and exegetical works, particularly the *Dhammasaṅgaṇi-aṭṭhakathā* (§1.4–2.2_2 ↔ §1309_0–1309_5), the *Majjhimanikāye Mūlapaṇṇāsa-aṭṭhakathā* (§1.2–1.6_1), the *Visuddhimagga* (second volume, §1.2–1.6_1), and the *Saṃyuttanikāye Khandhavagga-aṭṭhakathā* (§1.4–1.6_1) [DharmaNexus]. Within the *Milindapañha* corpus itself, it displays formulaic overlap with *Phassādivinibbhujanapañha* (Mil 3.4.1) and *Nāmarūpaekattanānattapañha* (Mil 3.2.6) [DharmaNexus].
